title: Gemini and Apex Fintech Solutions Partner to Bring Gemini’s Regulated Crypto Prediction Markets to Apex's Brokerage Network
summary: Gemini is now positioned to be the exclusive CFTC-regulated venue for crypto event contracts distributed through Apex's FCM.
body_markdown:
Today, Gemini Space Station, Inc. (“Gemini”) and Apex Fintech Solutions Inc. (“Apex”) announced they have signed a letter of intent under which Gemini Titan, a subsidiary of Gemini, would become the exclusive regulated venue for crypto event contracts distributed through Apex's Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) to Apex's brokerage customers.


Under the alliance, brokerages that offer crypto event contracts through Apex's FCM will use Gemini for execution and clearing – making Gemini the go-to regulated venue for crypto-based predictions markets accessed through Apex. Beyond crypto, Gemini affords Apex the flexibility to collaborate on additional contract categories, including sports, economics, and financial markets, on a non-exclusive basis.


This collaboration builds on Gemini's recent product and regulatory milestones. In April, its subsidiary, Gemini Olympus, obtained a CFTC Derivatives Clearing Organization (DCO) license, bringing derivatives clearing and settlement for Gemini Titan in-house. In December 2025, Gemini Titan secured a Designated Contract Market (DCM) license from the CFTC, enabling Gemini to launch predictions trading.


"Leveraging more than a decade of experience building and operating a regulated platform for crypto, a new and emergent asset class, we deliberately chose to build our predictions platform in-house,” said Tyler Winklevoss, CEO of Gemini. “We believe that predictions are the future of markets, and this strategy allows us to expand our offering and open access to valued partners like Apex as demand for event contracts grows.”


In July, Gemini announced the launch of stock trading with 0% commissions for certain customers in the United States with Apex Clearing Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of Apex acting as the custodian and clearing broker.


"At Apex, we've always believed in meeting the market where it's going," said Travis McGhee, Global Head of Digital Markets at Apex Fintech Solutions. "This partnership with Gemini is about building the bridge between traditional finance and what's next. Our brokerage clients get regulated access to crypto event contracts without having to build the plumbing themselves. That's the Apex model."


Gemini and Apex look forward to finalizing the details of this strategic collaboration in the coming weeks.
